summary.ko: 목표 길이와 제작 여건에 맞는 대본·장면·촬영 목록을 만듭니다.
summary.en: Turn a video brief into a timed script and feasible shot list.

triggers: write video script and shot list
exclusions: Editing already-shot footage without a new script

required_inputs.description: Audience, message, intended platform, and desired duration
Available people, locations, product assets, and production constraints

workflow.instruction: Define the opening promise, main message, and closing action based on the brief.
Write narration or dialogue with estimated timing and separate spoken text from on-screen text.
Map each beat to a feasible shot, action, framing, supporting asset, and audio requirement.
Check continuity, production feasibility, factual claims, and total estimated duration; flag shots needing assets or consent.

deliverables.name: Timed script
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Separates narration, on-screen text, visual cues, and timing estimates

deliverables.name: Shot list
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each shot has purpose, framing, action, assets, audio, and production notes

limitations: Timing is estimated until a real voice take or edit is measured.
The skill does not itself generate footage, voices, or music.
permission_boundaries: Do not impersonate people, clone voices, or use likenesses without the required consent.
Do not book production services, purchase media, or publish the video.
